summary.zh: 把笔记变成可翻页的网页幻灯片
summary.en: Turn markdown notes into a single-file slide deck

description.zh: 把 markdown 文件转成一个可独立打开的网页幻灯片，支持键盘翻页、演讲者备注和打印成 PDF。适合讲稿或笔记已经写好、需要快速做出演示稿并方便分发的时候。生成结果是单个文件，不需要服务器。
description.en: Turns a markdown file into one self-contained HTML deck with keyboard navigation, presenter notes and print-to-PDF. Good when notes already exist and you need slides fast; the output is a single file, no server.
